_comment: Template for the Teams cards created by 911 Setup's 'Generate Teams Cards' stage. Cards are driven by the EB 922 Schedule's CURRENT PIPELINE sheet: every row whose DEPT. is '911' AND whose STATUS is 'NEED TEAMS/SETUP' becomes one card in the MODELING bucket of the SOPO D911 PIPELINE plan. Edit this file to change the cards - no flow change is needed unless the payload SHAPE changes. 'label_map' mirrors the plan's label slots top-to-bottom (category1 = top of the label list); if a label is renamed or reordered IN TEAMS, update it here too.
_comment_tube_only: Checklist items dropped when the source material is not a tube (a tube-laser program is meaningless on saw stock). 'tube_keywords' is also the FIRST machine test - see machine rules below.
_comment_schedule: Which CURRENT PIPELINE rows become cards. Matched case-insensitively on the stripped cell value.
_comment_skips: Two reasons a queued nest gets NO card - both are reported at the end of the run, and both re-offer the nest on a later run once the missing piece appears. 'require_material_notes': the schedule's NOTES cell (column D) is blank, so the material has not been specified yet and the card could carry neither a machine label nor a Program decision (C.D. 2026-08-03). 'require_material_code': the nest's BATCH LIST 'Material' code could not be read, so the title would come out as 'BATCH: x - NEST: y' with no '(code)' - which does NOT match the real title later, defeating the flow's exact-title duplicate check and leaving you with two cards for one nest.
_comment_machine: SAW CUT vs TUBE LASER, read off the schedule's NOTES text (column D; falls back to the BATCH LIST 'Description' when NOTES is blank). Rule, in order (C.D. 2026-08-03): (1) the material says TUBE -> it IS a tube -> TUBE LASER; (2) otherwise a '(TL)' note means it is going on the tube laser anyway -> TUBE LASER; (3) everything else -> SAW CUT. Shape does NOT imply the tube laser - an angle is an angle. Only a material text that is entirely EMPTY gets no label at all, and that is reported at the end of the run.
_comment_labels: Slot keys, not names - the flow stays dumb and only sees categoryN. Order here mirrors the plan's label list top-to-bottom: slot 1 is the UNNAMED Pink default, then 2 DIFFICULT, 3 MEDIUM, 4 SIMPLE, 5 SAW CUT, 6 TUBE LASER. The first live post (2026-08-04) shipped with this map starting at category1 and every card's labels came out shifted one slot (SAW CUT lit up SIMPLE, so cards showed two difficulties) - verify against Teams' label list, which shows UNNAMED slots by their colour name.
